items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: James P. Johnson taught Vatwiler too, yeah. Vatwiler was a piano player

ctx.x: When you came back to New Orleans, you didn't start playing music right away? No, I learned how to play ukulele. Did you used to go around and listen to bands here? No. You must have been about 19.

You see, my sister used to work for Nashville, Albany and St. Charles, she worked for the family of Wilberforce had the music store. And Franklin Burr, he was singing then, the man he called Perry Mason. You understand what I mean? And he was singing, he used to sing that on records. And she used to bring all them records home and things like that. And she started bringing a lot of records home, and I ain't got nobody, you know Bobby himself playing piano and stuff like that.
